theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (A : Set (Euclid P)) (η : ℝ), 0 < η → μ univ < ∞ → (∀ x ∈ A, ENNReal.ofReal η ≤ liminf (fun r : ℝ => μ (ball x r) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0)) → μHE[n] A < ∞
